<Callout type="info">
  `GoogleGenerativeAIAdapter` has no direct v2 replacement. For v2, see [Runtime server adapter](/runtime-server-adapter).
</Callout>

Copilot Runtime adapter for Google Generative AI (e.g. Gemini).

## Example

The adapter reads `GOOGLE_API_KEY` unless you pass `apiKey`. Pass `copilotKit` and `serviceAdapter` to your runtime endpoint.

```ts
import { CopilotRuntime, GoogleGenerativeAIAdapter } from "@copilotkit/runtime";

const copilotKit = new CopilotRuntime();

const serviceAdapter = new GoogleGenerativeAIAdapter({
  model: "gemini-3.5-flash",
  apiVersion: "v1",
});
```

## Constructor Parameters

<PropertyReference name="model" type="string" default='"gemini-3.5-flash"'> 
A custom Google Generative AI model to use.
</PropertyReference>

<PropertyReference name="apiVersion" type="'v1' | 'v1beta'"  > 
The API version, `"v1"` or `"v1beta"`. When omitted, the Google provider default (`v1beta`) is used. Pass `"v1"` to pin v1. The adapter's console warning says it defaults to `"v1"`. Copilot Runtime uses the provider default instead.
</PropertyReference>

<PropertyReference name="apiKey" type="string"  > 
The API key to use.
</PropertyReference>
